name: boss-3-t
about: The title's containment hall: a lighter build of boss-3 (the same source, rig and clips), for a boss seen at the middle distance in its stasis pod. Boss Rush: Solvency Specter (a hooded wraith in tattered plate with an empty vault in its chest). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss03-specter-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): a figure seen at middle distance (the title's pods): 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps, about 20K triangles
